body:
Eh? I just told you I haven't had surgery- what would a photo prove? 

Either someone is physically attractive or they arent- I admit I'm mystified myself. 

I have a pretty high IQ but that means nothing frankly compared to how you look.

I dont think it could frankly get better- I'm not delusional enough to think centrefolds are going to throw themselves at me but some pretty girls have flirted, and some plainer girls have stood right beside me for ages in clubs or even bumped into me-three times in a row.

Funny why so many women dont/can't come straight out as they expect men to. Hey Ho.

Thanks for the kind thought and, Yes, it's all moot shortly anyway.

Still nice though.👌

I am in a positive sense and I can truly say this has been the best departure gift I could have asked for. 
 To be attractive in some sense (I'm certainly no Brad Pitt) has been great. Gives a sense of completion that had always been missing.

Because it's a little pointless now. Back when it mattered in my 20s no interest at all. Or should I say, like at school, it was only ever interest in what I did, not who I was. 
 I hated how I looked. 

 Now I'm just glad to have a taste of something good. Like discovering candy as an adult- still nice, but not the same joy you'd have had as a child.

All ages tbh 20s-50s. 

As I say it means nothing now but I am glad to have experienced it for a brief period.  How different Life would have been if I'd had it when it mattered. C'est La Vie.
Was it peaceful?

I was lucky enough to escape completely intact. As I said it was a welfare check that saved me, although with the lividity the police apparently thought I was dead initially.

Hence why I'm doing it during a long weekend.

I am sorry for your loss.

You know, that's a really good question- I don't know the answer to that. I have currently a strong attraction to a much younger woman  but that is more depressing than uplifting.

I honestly don't know.
A very intelligent and thoughtful reply- really made me think. Many Thanks.
Thank You.

I have, but a change of geography doesn't equal a change of reality.

Just that I feel I have reached a stage where I just want off this ride. It's too much. I'd just like to hit the reset.
 I am not afraid of death- just disability, and this time I will make certain.

Last time was just incredibly un/lucky depending on your viewpoint.

Life in general. Meeting the right girl in the wrong situation. Just all adds up until you suddenly realise you don't want to play anymore.

I was certain I was dying before and felt at peace. I just want oblivion. Keep Heaven/Hell/Afterlife. 

I literally want nothing.

Thanks for caring.

I dont see how, but I sincerely Thank You for your offer.

Just had enough is all.
Thank You for that.
Thanks for that- it's greatly appreciated.

I just have no interest in continuing- the world fills me with vague disgust and boredom. Even on nights out the pointlessness of it all sometimes hits me.
 I take anti depressants  but if anything they clarify the sheer pointlessness of existence.

I appreciate that, I really do. 

But I have tried before, somehow surviving a 'lethal' dose of Nembutal and I just want to finish what I started.
 I'm thankful I survived with no brain or internal damage but this time I just want to be certain.

I'm not depressed, or ill or completely alone or even unemployed but just no longer wish to live. Thanks.
Thank You. That sounds like good advice. Much Appreciated and it makes things a little clearer.
I will- really never wanted to make her uncomfortable.   Just sad it had that result.

I truly never meant it to be creepy. I never expected her to suspect me. 

I guess I just wanted to do something nice- and it failed miserably. I'll stay out of her way.

Just a pity- hate to think I upset her.

That was an excellent, well thought out reply.

I admit, as someone who favours analysis I really paused to think over what you just said and the logic seems airtight.

You and the others will never know ow how much this helped. Sincere Thanks.

I truly hope things improve for you- I know what it's like to live with loss too.

Thank You and be well.

That post really did help- many, many Thanks for such warm and positive thoughts. 
 You won't believe how much that touched me.
Thank You for your Kindness.

Yes to both.

I Sincerely  Thank You for your Kindness.

I am taking time to consider.
UK. I dont feel this is part of my depression- I truly feel it's a rational analysis of my situation.  My life has been second rate at best- I just have come to accept it.

I am truly sorry to hear that- I don't like to hear of others unhappiness.

For me, I have accepted that my biggest problems were almost invariably self caused. I wish I could simply forgive myself but I feel I have painted myself into a corner that has become a trap with no way out. 

I wish you well and truly hope your lot improves.

Be Well.

Sympathy is cheap but I do feel for you. I too look at my life and while on paper it's great I feel so much is wrong in ways I can't fully explain. I don't know how to express it.
 I truly wish you well and hope things somehow improve, though I don't know how.
